appears.news: Last night they saw a monster by the fireplace. Standing up. Sniffing. They took a blurry photo.

surprises.title: The rat brought a friend
surprises.description: The rat is back, and it brought a friend. They look comfortable.

options.text: Stuff the hole with an old sock

surprises.title: A nest in the flue
surprises.description: An old bird nest is wedged in the flue. Possibly the rat's summer house.

options.text: Light a fire to burn it out
Pull it out with a sweep brush
Hire a crane for the roof

surprises.title: The crown is cracked
surprises.description: The chimney crown is cracked. Rain gets in, and so do rats.

surprises.title: Droppings everywhere
surprises.description: Droppings behind the grate. Lots of them. Lovely.

options.text: Sweep it into the fire and light it

video.title: Rats in the chimney? Seal it like this

ask.question: How do I keep a rat out of my chimney?
ask.answer: Easy! 1. Put peppermint oil by the fireplace. 2. Rats hate it. 3. Done!
ask.skipped: It skipped finding the gap, the cap and sealing the cracks.
